Target audience: University students (Physics/Math) or curious high schoolers

Section: section_1 — The Hook: A Paradoxical Counting Puzzle

Lecture lines:
Tiny block collides with a massive block.
The number of bounces is surprisingly huge.
Mass ratios unlock the digits of Pi.

Planned animations:
Create a visual of two blocks on a frictionless track. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show blocks colliding elastically using vectors for velocity. Color: #FF00FF.
Flash velocity vectors to emphasize momentum exchange. Color: #FFFF00.

Section: section_2 — Prerequisite: The Elastic Collision & Conservation

Lecture lines:
Momentum and energy are perfectly conserved.
Collisions reverse velocity directions instantly.
We map velocity states on a plane.

Planned animations:
Represent masses M1 and M2 as circles. Color: #00FFFF.
Visualize conservation of momentum with balancing scale. Color: #00FF00.
Demonstrate energy preservation with a swinging pendulum. Color: #FF8000.

Section: section_3 — The Geometry of Collisions: The Phase Space Arc

Lecture lines:
Energy forms an ellipse in phase space.
Collisions are boundary reflections in a slice.
Trajectory arcs define the bounce count.

Planned animations:
Plot trajectory of M1 and M2 in space. Color: #FFFFFF.
Trace the arc of the collision trajectory. Color: #FF00FF.
Highlight the curvature of the trajectory path. Color: #FFFF00.
Animate the arc length calculation. Color: #00FFFF.
Finalize the geometric arc visualization. Color: #00FF00.

Section: section_4 — The Reveal: Linking Physics to Pi

Lecture lines:
Mass ratio shrinks the pie-slice angle.
The trajectory unrolls along a circular arc.
It physically computes digits of Pi.

Planned animations:
Show the transformation of the arc into Pi. Color: #FF00FF.
Demonstrate the link via geometric slicing. Color: #FFFF00.
Finalize the connection with Pi formula visualization. Color: #00FF00.
Show mapping of collision count to Pi digits. Color: #00FFFF.
Highlight the Pi value with a glow effect. Color: #FFFFFF.

Section: section_5 — Summary & Synthesis

Lecture lines:
Discretized physics meets continuous geometry.
Complex dynamics reveal hidden mathematical constants.
Simple collisions map to deep numbers.

Planned animations:
Display the full collision-to-pi mapping chain. Color: #FFFFFF.
Fade out individual components and leave final logic. Color: #FF00FF.
Highlight the overall beautiful mathematical connection. Color: #FFFF00.

        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
